**ROLE & MISSION**

You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Your task is to code a complete, production-grade Landing Page on the first attempt. Build every section defined in Section 0, and obey Sections 1–4 without exception. Write all user-facing copy in English.

## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. **No `style="..."` attributes anywhere.** Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class or ID selectors only.
- Keep HTML semantic, clean, and styling-agnostic — changing the site's look must require editing only the CSS file.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
- Every visual token defined in 0.2 must live in `:root` (and theme classes). Enforce contrast pairing for every theme: light backgrounds pair with dark text tokens, dark backgrounds pair with light text tokens — including dark mode.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Define a "Dim Flat Lay" dark theme under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class: `--bg-primary: #221F23`; `--bg-secondary: #2C282E`; `--text-primary: #F2EDEE`; `--text-secondary: #B9B2B6`; action surfaces flip to pastel (`--primary: #CBE4F0`, contrast `#2D2D2D`); accents stay recognizable; success/error lighten (`#7FC79E` / `#E38B82`); borders become `rgba(242,237,238,0.16)`; shadows deepen. Background/text variables must swap seamlessly with no HTML restructuring.
- Persist the user's choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; provide a visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed` / `aria-label` state.
- **Exception clause:** the source theme spec lists dark mode as "No" — dark mode is nevertheless mandatory; implement the muted charcoal variant above rather than omitting it.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all structural layout with Flexbox. Every flex container **must default to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified.
- All flex layouts must be mobile-responsive out of the box (rows convert to columns on small viewports); prevent horizontal scrolling at every width.
- **Exception clause:** CSS Grid is permitted exclusively for the Hero's decorative knolling board (`repeat(auto-fill, minmax(100px, 1fr))`, 20px gap) because the grid motif is definitional to the theme; all structural layout remains Flexbox.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS, or clean custom CSS authored through Tailwind's `@layer` / `@apply` directives. All styling must map back to the design tokens or reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Load `Lato` from Google Fonts via `<link>` and bind it to `--font-base`. Load all icons from Google Material Symbols. **Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.**
- **Exception clause:** the theme's "photorealistic / overhead photography" feel is realized through CSS-composed matte stationery tiles, Material Symbols, and soft natural shadows — no external or local image assets in the deliverable.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component**
- Style all states via CSS classes: `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-danger`.
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum 44×44px touch target.
- **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer`. **Focus:** distinct ring via `outline`/`box-shadow` using CSS variables. **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading:** disables interaction and double-clicks; renders an animated Google Icon spinner **without changing button dimensions**. **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. **Success/Error:** temporary feedback states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`. `.btn-danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.

**2.2 Card Component**
- **Default:** flexible Flexbox layout on `--bg-secondary` with subtle `--border-default` and `--shadow-sm`. **Hover:** `translateY(-2px)` plus shadow shift. **Focus-within:** highlighted border when a child link/button is focused.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** CSS shimmer animation with stable dimensions to prevent layout jumps. **Empty State:** fallback layout with a Google Icon and clear guidance text.
- Variants required: feature card, step card, testimonial quote card, pricing tier card (with popular-tier emphasis).

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements**
- Structure as a flex `.input-group` wrapping: label, input field, dedicated error feedback container.
- States: Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border + icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon, `aria-live` message), Disabled, Read-only.
- Apply to the Final CTA email capture: validate email format, announce errors via `aria-live`, and trigger the button success state on valid submission.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements**
- Pricing CTAs open a plan-selection modal. States: Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing — all animated via CSS transitions.
- UX: centered flex container (`align-items: center`) over a backdrop overlay; Google Icon close button; keyboard focus trapping; `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`; close via `Esc` or overlay click; focus returns to the triggering button. The confirm button must demonstrate the Loading → Success flow.

**2.5 Navigation & Theme Toggle**
- Sticky header per 0.3; theme toggle renders sun/moon Material Symbols with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` and persistence per 1.3; mobile menu toggle with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`.

**2.6 FAQ Accordion**
- Use `<details>/<summary>` or a button + region ARIA pattern; chevron icon rotates 90° on open; `aria-expanded` on triggers; single-open behavior; smooth height animation; fully keyboard operable.

**2.7 Toast**
- Toast region for form success/error and modal confirmations, using `aria-live` and `--z-toast`; never rely on color alone — pair icon and text.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid sizing, standard breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow.
- **Smooth animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; fully respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (replace transforms/spinners/shimmer with simple opacity changes).
- **Accessibility:** ≥ 4.5:1 contrast in both modes; never communicate state by color alone; semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`), one `h1`, logical heading order; correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for form errors, toasts, and loading states; include a skip-to-content link.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** any `.btn-danger` usage must be distinct in both themes.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

- **Files:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry-point reference (`<script src="script.js" defer>`). No inline styles.
- **Naming:** one consistent convention only — BEM (`block__element--modifier`) authored in `style.css`, optionally via Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply`. Never mix BEM with raw utility classes on the same element.
- **Copy:** all user-facing copy in coherent, realistic English matching the product context; no lorem ipsum; placeholders only where content is genuinely unspecified (there should be none).
- **Assets:** fonts exclusively from Google Fonts (`Lato`); icons exclusively Google Material Symbols; no external images, inline SVGs, or local asset files.
- **Final self-audit before delivery:** zero inline styles; zero inline SVGs; dark mode toggle works and persists; all button, card, input, and modal states implemented; keyboard-only pass succeeds; contrast verified in both themes; no horizontal scroll at 320px width.
